headline: OpenAI paper encodes Turing-machine halting in forced Navier–Stokes particle motion
summary: An OpenAI-authored paper constructs a smooth external force that encodes any finite Turing machine and input into a Navier–Stokes flow: from zero initial velocity, one fixed particle enters a fixed open region exactly if the machine halts. The core construction uses fixed positive computable viscosity, compact spatial support and bounded kinetic energy. These are source-reported mathematical results, not independently reviewed here. The construction is forced and remains globally smooth; it does not show unforced blowup or resolve the Clay Millennium problem.
